title: Capability Preview Variant
description: One preview of a multi-capability build: a preview ID, one or more renders, the default input that produced them, and the creative capability (or, deprecated, the named format) it was generated for.

format_id.description: Deprecated named-format correlation for a legacy target_format_ids request.

capability_id.description: Canonical creative capability this preview was generated through. Matches one requested target_capability_ids entry.

renders.description: Array of rendered pieces for this format's preview. Most formats render as a single piece. Companion ad formats render as multiple pieces.

input.description: The input parameters that generated this preview. For multi-format responses, this is always a default input.
